spec.description: Machine Performance Dashboard for all machines, or a signle machine

spec.query:
System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgNetUtilizationPercent = round(avg(NetUtilizationPercent),1)

options.content:
## Machine Performance Data for [[Computer]] (Top [[TopN]])
Included VDA Metrics

spec.title: CPU usage and relative frequency over time (Top [[TopN]])

spec.query:
System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize ["Avg. CPU usage (%)"] = round(avg(CPUUsagePercent),1) by bin(Timestamp, $__interval)
| take [[TopN]]
| order by Timestamp desc

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize ["Avg. CPU relative frequency (%)"] = round(avg(CPURelativeFrequencyPercent),1) by bin(Timestamp, $__interval)
| order by Timestamp desc

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize RAMUsagePercent = [[Function]](RAMUsagePercent) by Host
| extend [[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent=round(RAMUsagePercent, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent
| take [[TopN]]
| project Host, [[Function]]_RAMUsagePercent

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize NetUtilizationPercent = [[Function]](NetUtilizationPercent) by Host
| extend [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent=round(NetUtilizationPercent, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent
| take [[TopN]]
| project Host, [[Function]]_NetUtilizationPercent

Citrix_Machines
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp,*) by Hash
| project SiteName,CatalogDisplayName,DesktopGroupDisplayName,HypervisorDisplayName,IPAddress,EffectiveLoadIndex,IsInMaintenanceMode,IsPendingUpdate,AgentVersion,ControllerDnsName,PoweredOnDate

System_GpuUsage
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
|where DisplayAdapterName !contains "Citrix" and DisplayAdapterName !contains "VMWare" and DisplayAdapterName !contains "Microsoft"
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize ["Video Memory"] = round(avg(MemoryDedicatedPercent),1) by bin(Timestamp, $__interval)

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize CPUUsagePercentRaw = [[Function]](CPUUsagePercent) by Host
| extend [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent = round(CPUUsagePercentRaw, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent
| take [[TopN]]
| project Host, [[Function]]_CPUUsagePercent

System_GpuUsage
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
|where DisplayAdapterName !contains "Citrix" and DisplayAdapterName !contains "VMWare" and DisplayAdapterName !contains "Microsoft"
| summarize adapter = arg_max(MemoryDedicatedSizeMB,*)
| take [[TopN]]
| project DisplayAdapterName

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| summarize IOPercentDiskTime = [[Function]](IOPercentDiskTime) by Host
| extend [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime=round(IOPercentDiskTime, 1)
| order by [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime
| take [[TopN]]
| project Host, [[Function]]_IOPercentDiskTime

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgCPUUsagePercent = round(avg(CPUUsagePercent),1)

spec.title: CPU rel. frequency
spec.description: Shows the percentage of throttling being done to the CPU for power savings.

spec.query:
System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgCPURelativeFrequencyPercent = round(avg(CPURelativeFrequencyPercent),1)

System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Host matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| take [[TopN]]
| summarize AvgRAMUsagePercent = round(avg(RAMUsagePercent),1)

spec.title: Machine Performance VDI View

spec.name: Computer
spec.label: Computer (regex, case-sensitiv):

spec.query:
System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| distinct Host
| project Host = strcat('"', Host, '"')
